a.lede: The FCC has granted SpaceX's request to deploy 1 million satellites to build an AI data center in orbit.
a.title: SpaceX gets FCC approval to deploy 1 million satellites for its AI orbital data center

b.lede: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.
b.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
